data.name: TextFieldsDescription
data.value: The single-line box in every type, the multi-line area and the password, with their label and form field. Each value is echoed as you type.

data.name: TextFieldsSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the four fields of the preview at once.

data.name: TextFieldsTypeDescription
data.value: The type changes the mobile keyboard and the browser autofill, never the value.

data.name: TextFieldsPlaceholderDescription
data.value: A sample shown while the field is empty.

data.name: TextFieldsDisabledDescription
data.value: The field can be neither focused nor edited.

data.name: TextFieldsReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The field can be focused and copied, not edited.

data.name: TextFieldsMaxLengthDescription
data.value: The browser stops typing at this length. Zero removes the limit.

data.name: TextFieldsDebounceDescription
data.value: The bound value waits for 400 ms of calm instead of following every keystroke.

data.name: TextFieldsShowCountDescription
data.value: Shown under the multi-line area when a maximum length is set.

data.name: TextFieldsRowsDescription
data.value: The height of the multi-line area, in lines.

data.name: TextFieldsRevealableDescription
data.value: Lets the user read the password they typed.

data.name: TextFieldsRequiredDescription
data.value: Adds the asterisk to the label. It does not validate anything by itself.

data.name: TextFieldsShowDescriptionDescription
data.value: A line under the label, linked to the field for screen readers.

data.name: TextFieldsShowErrorDescription
data.value: The form field shows an error and takes its invalid look.

data.name: NumbersDescription
data.value: A numeric field typed by its value: integer, decimal or nullable, with bounds and a step. The value is echoed and flagged when it leaves the bounds.

data.name: NumbersSettingsDescription
data.value: The bounds apply to the three fields of the preview.

data.name: NumbersMinimumDescription
data.value: Passed to the browser, which uses it for the arrows; the component does not enforce it.

data.name: NumbersMaximumDescription
data.value: Same as the minimum: a hint to the browser, not a rule.

data.name: NumbersIntegerStepDescription
data.value: What the arrows and the keyboard add or remove on the integer fields.

data.name: NumbersDecimalStepDescription
data.value: The step of the decimal field.

data.name: NumbersPlaceholderDescription
data.value: Only visible on an empty field, so on the nullable one.

data.name: NumbersDisabledDescription
data.value: The fields can be neither focused nor edited.

data.name: NumbersReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The fields can be focused and copied, not edited.

data.name: TogglesDescription
data.value: Two-state and three-state boxes and switches. Each value is echoed, including the null third state.

data.name: TogglesSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the four controls of the preview.

data.name: TogglesDisabledDescription
data.value: The controls keep their value but no longer change it.

data.name: TogglesAllowIndeterminateDescription
data.value: Off, a click only cycles between yes and no; the null state stays reachable from the buttons below.

data.name: TogglesShowLabelsDescription
data.value: Without them, each control carries its name as an accessible label only.

data.name: TogglesTextFirstDescription
data.value: The text of a check box or a switch goes before it, as in a settings row.

data.name: TogglesResetDescription
data.value: Forces the four values at once; null only reaches the three-state controls.

data.name: ValidationDescription
data.value: A small sign-up form whose required rule sits next to the fields it guards, then a form whose length, e-mail and comparison rules are carried by the model.

data.name: ValidationSettingsDescription
data.value: Where messages appear, when they appear, and how a valid form answers.

data.name: ValidationPlacementDescription
data.value: Under each validator, inside the form field, or gathered in a summary above the form.

data.name: ValidationDelayDescription
data.value: How long a validator waits after the last keystroke before checking.

data.name: ValidationFocusFirstInvalidDescription
data.value: On a refused submission, the focus moves to the first invalid field.

data.name: ValidationFeedbackDescription
data.value: A notification in the site stack, or an alert under the form.

data.name: ValidationAnnotationsDescription
data.value: Length, e-mail and comparison rules carried by the model's DataAnnotations: OmniDataAnnotationsValidator writes the standard messages in the interface language.

data.name: UnsavedChangesDescription
data.value: Unsaved changes guard: before leaving the page, a navigation inside the application waits for a confirmation and closing the tab raises the browser's own question.

data.name: UnsavedChangesSettingsDescription
data.value: The state the guard watches and the texts of its question.

data.name: UnsavedChangesHasChangesDescription
data.value: Turned off, every navigation goes through without a question.

data.name: UnsavedChangesCustomTextsDescription
data.value: Replaces the package's localized title, question and two buttons.

data.name: FormLayoutsDescription
data.value: A vertical form: label above the field, asterisk on the required fields, help and error lines, a summary of the errors, then the disabled and read-only states.

data.name: FormLayoutsVerticalDescription
data.value: The two errors are real validation errors of the edit context: each field takes its invalid state from them, and fixing them removes them from the summary.

data.name: FormLayoutsChoicesTitle
data.value: Selection, date, choice and file fields

data.name: FormLayoutsChoicesDescription
data.value: A drop-down, the three pickers, a radio list and the three shapes of the upload. The strategy error is a real validation error of the edit context: the choice list takes aria-invalid and its error line from it, and choosing a strategy removes it from the summary.
